children.note:
TRACE-TS: Attribution-Grounded and Traceable Sensor-Language Reasoning for Human Activity Understanding

一句话概括

研究问题

针对的大问题是HAR传统分类模型仅仅为了完成分类任务，而不考虑解释性。从而推出LLM导向的模型。随后指出当前这些模型的解释只是plausible，而不faithful。

  1. Grounding limitation：没有具体到具体传感器数据（grounded in sensor evidence）；
  2. Reasoning limitation：解释并不可追踪（explanations should be traceable）；
  3. 指出评估应当可诊断（diagnostic），这主要是为了引出他提出的评价指标SNM。

提到传统的HAR模型的label空间有限，但似乎没有怎么关注这个问题。应该只是引出LLM方法的背景。

方法与主要贡献

将传统流程从 【数据】-->【结果】变为【数据】-->【锚定的证据】-->【有向无环图（DAG）的推理】-->【结果】

这里DAG的层数是固定的，节点数与连接关系不是。也算是一种把归因展现出来的模板？

Stage 0

论文中将其算在Stage1中

训练expert HAR模型（$C=\text{Attend-and-Discriminate}$），应当是正常训练的一个分类模型，论文没有给出明确设置。

Stage 1

提取expert HAR模型训练正确的样本继续（错误的直接舍去），利用 IG 与SHAP归因，然后送入teacher LLM生成DAG，用于Stage 2的训练。这一阶段没有参数被训练

Stage 2

原始sensor数据通过预训练时序小模型（MantisV2，冻结）后，通过projector（训练）映射到语言模型空间，作为Sensor Memory。将其插入语言模型（冻结）的每个decoder layer：

$$H^{(l)}=H^{(l-1)}+\alpha_l\operatorname{CrossAttn}(Q,K,V)$$

其中 $K$，$V$来自Sensor Memory，$Q$来自$H^{(l-1)}$. 输出DAG后与Stage 1中的DAG计算loss。

局限与适用范围

Stage1（即teacher那一条路）将expert HAR分类错误的舍弃了，那么应当也不会进入到Stage2的student的学习（但是原文似乎没有提到）。也就是说，模型完全只从分类正确的模型中学到了DAG，那么是否某些特定的模式就被忽视了呢？文章并没有指出丢弃了多少样本，以及丢弃了的样本的处理。

teacher的推理图的ground truth是LLM生成的，所以上限还是取决于LLM。

是否只是学习了在特定样本上的（expert HAR分类正确的），由Attribution（由IG+SHAP组成）+被限定了推理方式为DAG的LLM的知识？

meta.title: TRACE-TS: Attribution-Grounded and Traceable Sensor-Language Reasoning for Human Activity Understanding

zotero.abstractNote: Wearable sensors capture fine-grained motion patterns that support rich behavioral understanding, yet most existing methods reduce these signals to activity labels. Recent LM-based approaches generate natural-language explanations for sensor data, but their reasoning is weakly grounded in the underlying signal, leading to fluent yet unverifiable explanations. We introduce TRACE-TS (Traceable Reasoning with Attribution-Grounded Evidence), a framework for structured and signal-grounded reasoning over wearable time series. TRACE-TS uses attribution from an expert classifier to identify salient spatio-temporal sensor regions, uses them to construct DAG reasoning traces with explicit evidence provenance, and trains a compact language model to generate these traces through gated cross-attention over sensor memory tokens. At inference, the adapted model jointly outputs the activity prediction and its reasoning trace, without requiring attribution computation or teacher guidance. We introduce Semantic Node Match(SNM), an LLM-as-judge metric that diagnoses reasoning fidelity at the observation, inference, and synthesis levels, localizing hallucinated observations and broken evidence chains missed by standard NLG metrics. Across seven wearable benchmarks, TRACE-TS achieves the best average accuracy and F1 among all evaluated methods (84.43%/81.24%), and outperforms the best LLM-based baseline by 17.96% in F1. Our code is available at https://github.com/SparshRastogi/TRACE-TS.
